theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (g : Euclid n → Euclid P) (A : Set (Euclid n)) (L : NNReal) (c : ℝ), 1 ≤ n → LipschitzWith L g → MeasurableSet A → 0 < c → (∀ a ∈ A, ∀ a' ∈ A, c * ‖a - a'‖ ≤ ‖g a - g a'‖) → (∀ a ∈ A, DifferentiableAt ℝ g a ∧ Injective (fderiv ℝ g a)) → ∀ᵐ a ∂(volume.restrict A), HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt n (g '' A) (g a) (LinearMap.range (fderiv ℝ g a : Euclid n →ₗ[ℝ] Euclid P))
